text: Therefore, from that inversion, and from the aforementioned inversion of the three gunas, the quality-less Purusha is misapprehended as possessing qualities such as being the discerner and the enjoyer. From this stated inversion of the Purusha, the Purusha's status as a witness to the agents—Sattva, Rajas, and Tamas—is established. This [argument] is directed toward [proving] plurality.
